Fall 2026

This schedule is for most Regular Session classes. Special Session classes normally schedule culminating activities on the last day of the term. Check with your syllabus for class specific information.

  • Classes with meeting times other than those identified in the below Culminating Activities and Final Examinations Schedule, or which cannot be held at the scheduled time, should utilize the Make-Up period provided. 
  • Classes with two meeting patterns should schedule using the first meeting pattern listed in MySJSU (PeopleSoft). 
  • Online/Hybrid classes without a designated day and time, (TBA) as their first (or only) meeting pattern, should utilize the Online/Hybrid Classes section provided. 
  • Online/Hybrid classes with a designated day and time, as their first (or only) meeting pattern, should utilize the schedule as identified in the appropriate section (Group I, Group II, Late Afternoon, Night, or Saturday).

Group I | Group II | Late Afternoon | Night | Saturday | Online/Hybrid | Make-Up | Common Final Examinations for MATH Classes 

Group I Classes

Group I classes are those classes which meet M, W, F, MTW, MWR, MTWF, MWRF, MTWRF, MW, WF, MWF, MF, TW, WR, MT, WS.

Class Start Times Final Exam Days Final Exam Times
7:00 thru 8:25 AM Fri, December 11 8:30-10:30 AM
8:30 thru 9:25 AM Mon, December 14 8:30-10:30 AM
9:30 thru 10:25 AM Wed, December 9 8:30-10:30 AM
10:30 thru 11:25 AM Fri, December 11 10:45 AM-12:45 PM
11:30 AM thru 12:25 PM Wed, December 9 10:45 AM-12:45 PM
12:30 thru 1:25 PM Wed, December 9 1:00-3:00 PM
1:30 thru 2:25 PM Mon, December 14 1:00-3:00 PM
2:30 thru 3:25 PM Fri, December 11 3:15-5:15 PM
3:30 thru 4:25 PM Mon, December 14 3:15-5:15 PM
4:30 thru 5:25 PM Wed, December 9 3:15-5:15 PM

Classes with meeting times other than those identified in the Culminating Activities and Final Examinations Schedule, or which cannot be examined at the scheduled time, should utilize the "Make-Up" period provided.

Group II Classes

Group II classes are those classes which meet TR, T, R, TWR, MTR, TRF, MTRF, MTWR, TWRF, RF, RFS,TF, TRS.

Class Start Times Final Exam Days Final Exam Times
7:00 thru 8:25 AM Tue, December 15 8:30-10:30 AM
8:30 thru 9:25 AM Thu, December 10 8:30-10:30 AM
9:30 thru 10:25 AM Tue, December 15 8:30-10:30 AM
10:30 thru 11:25 AM Thu, December 10 10:45 AM-12:45 PM
11:30 AM thru 12:25 PM Tue, December 15 10:45 AM-12:45 PM
12:30 thru 1:25 PM Thu, December 10 1:00-3:00 PM
1:30 thru 2:25 PM Tue, December 15 1:00-3:00 PM
2:30 thru 3:25 PM Thu, December 10 1:00-3:00 PM
3:30 thru 4:25 PM Tue, December 15 3:15-5:15 PM
4:30 thru 5:25 PM Thu, December 10 3:15-5:15 PM

Classes with meeting times other than those identified in the Culminating Activities and Final Examinations Schedule, or which cannot be examined at the scheduled time, should utilize the "Make-Up" period provided.

Late Afternoon Classes

Late afternoon and night classes meeting more than once per week should schedule their Culminating Activities and Final Examinations on the earliest possible date. Example: final exam for ENGL 1A which meets on MWF from 6:00-7:30 PM should be scheduled on Wed, December 9 from 5:30-7:30 PM (not Mon, December 14).

Class Start Times Final Exam Days Final Exam Times
Mon 5:30 thru 6:25 PM   Mon, December 14 5:30-7:30 PM
Tue 5:30 thru 6:25 PM  Tue, December 15 5:30-7:30 PM
Wed 5:30 thru 6:25 PM  Wed, December 9 5:30-7:30 PM
Thu 5:30 thru 6:25 PM  Thu, December 10 5:30-7:30 PM
Fri 5:30 thru 6:25 PM  Fri, December 11 5:30-7:30 PM

Night Classes

Late afternoon and night classes meeting more than once per week should schedule their Culminating Activities and Final Examinations on the earliest possible date. Example: final exam for ENGL 1A which meets on MWF from 6:30-7:45 PM should be scheduled on Wed, December 9 from 7:45-9:45 PM (not Mon, December 14).

Class Start Times Final Exam Days Final Exam Times
Mon 6:30 PM or Later Mon, December 14 7:45-9:45 PM
Tue 6:30 PM or Later Tue, December 15 7:45-9:45 PM
Wed 6:30 PM or Later Wed, December 9 7:45-9:45 PM
Thu 6:30 PM or Later Thu, December 10 7:45-9:45 PM
Fri 6:30 PM or Later Fri, December 11 7:45-9:45 PM

Saturday Classes

All Saturday classes will administer Culminating Activities and Final Examinations on Saturday, December 12, at the regularly scheduled class start time, for 2 hours.

Online Classes/Hybrid Classes

Online/Hybrid classes without a designated day and time, (TBA) as their first (or only) meeting pattern, are to administer their Culminating Activities and Final Examinations during any of the following time periods: 

Final Exam Days Final Exam Times
Thu, December 10 5:30-7:30 PM
Thu, December 10 7:45-9:45 PM
Fri, December 11 5:30-7:30 PM
Fri, December 11 7:45-9:45 PM
Wed, December 16 All day

Make-Up Exams

Any make-up Culminating Activities and Final Examinations are held on Wed, December 16 (all day).

Common Final Examinations for MATH Classes

Common Final Examinations for MATH classes apply to the following courses: MATH 18A, 19, 30, 31, 32, 42, and 70. These courses administer common finals which do not follow the standard schedule for Culminating Activities and Final Examinations Period schedule. Questions should be addressed to the Department of Mathematics & Statistics. Subject to change. 

Courses Final Exam Day Final Exam Times
MATH 19, and 30 Sat, Dec 12 8:30-10:30 AM
MATH 31 and 32 

Sat, Dec 12

 11:00 AM-1:00 PM
MATH 42, and 70

Sat, Dec 12

 1:30-3:30 PM
MATH 18A  Sat, Dec 12 4:00-6:00 PM
